description: Convert text to speech using a specified voice.

model_id.description: The ID of the text-to-speech model to use; defaults to eleven_multilingual_v2 when omitted.

output_format.description: The audio output format for the generated speech, such as mp3_44100_128 or pcm_44100.

text.description: The text to convert to speech.

voice_id.description: The ID of the voice to use for speech generation; the documented default voice applies when omitted.

name: text_to_speech
